description: This file declares functions and variables related to comfort noise generation in AMR speech codec, including pseudonoise, build_CN_code, and build_CN_param functions, with external variables and macros.

methods.name: pseudonoise
methods.description: Generates a random integer value using a polynomial for comfort noise.

methods.name: build_CN_code
methods.description: Computes the comfort noise fixed codebook excitation with gains of pulses +/-1.

methods.name: build_CN_param
methods.description: Randomizes speech parameters to prevent tonal artifacts.
